command: set -euo pipefail; echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname); echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un); test "$(hostname)" = "andreas-MACO"; state=$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service || true); echo PRE_STATE=$state; test "$state" = inactive -o "$state" = failed; echo CONDITION_BEGIN; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition; echo CONDITION_END; manifest=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; test -f "$manifest"; got=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$manifest" | awk '{print $1}'); echo MANIFEST_SHA=$got; test "$got" = "fe7cd20eb0574799d84ac4dd15d089948490fd1fb113a1cbec5aafefd950c916"; echo START_ONCE=1; sudo -n systemctl start entityos-vm.service; post=$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service); pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value); epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value); echo POST_STATE=$post; echo POST_PID=$pid; echo POST_EPOCH=$epoch; test "$post" = active; test "$pid" -gt 0; echo NO_RESTART=1; echo START_REENTRY_PASS=1
